All four workflows are now executed end-to-end with results, and the monoclonal.md contract verifies 316/316 checks. Final state:

Workflows (4 designed / 4 selected / 4 executed):

run_001 — AbFlow H3 pose-blind (paper Table 1 protocol) — completed earlier. AAR 0.5263, DockQ 0.889.

run_004 — AbFlow multi-CDR (paper Table 2 track, declared separate) — completed earlier. AAR 0.4211.

run_002 — DiffAb (open source, since no Boltzmann/ToolUniverse equivalent exists) — executed this round:
- codesign_single.pt, H_CDR3, 32 samples, in-context protocol (pose-conditioned — declared protocol difference, never merged with pose-blind numbers)
- 32 unique H3s, 0 native copies, framework native
- Scored with the authors' evaluator on grafted IMGT-compatible models: AAR H3 0.2747 ± 0.0693, CAAR 0.1458, RMSD H3 in-place 4.55 Å, TM 0.9785, lDDT 0.8956, DockQ 0.5877 — below AbFlow's recovery, consistent with the paper's own DiffAb finding

run_003 — AntiBMPNN (Boltzmann platform, priority 1) — executed this round as the user-authorized declared native-backbone variant:
- H3 masked to GLY backbone-only, platform job 6af884b7239a6b9f38bec1e5 (Success, 98 s, 1 billing unit)
- First submission failed on IMGT insertion codes → bounded recovery (sequential renumbering) → second submission succeeded — all documented as fallback records
- 32 sequences, frozen by the tool's own model score, scored: AAR H3 0.5526 ± 0.0671 (rank-1 0.5789), CAAR 0.3542; structural metrics by-construction trivial (fixed backbone), explicitly labelled not-comparable

Mid-run bugs found, fixed, and documented in the records: graft insertion-code column formatting, a model-builder that dropped chains, and the evaluator's DockQ cwd dependency (caught via a native-vs-native control test: AAR 1.0, TM 1.0 — then full rescore of all 64 candidates).

Everything delivered under the monoclonal.md structure: configs/ (4 full JSONs with tool_calls, parameters, payloads, execution records, fallbacks), src/ (4 run trees with workflow.md, run.yaml, code, inputs, both markdown logs), results/ (4 full per-run trees with reports, candidates/shortlist/metrics/FASTA/benchmark CSVs, structures, raw), all run.yaml config hashes verified, task-level Results md updated with the cross-run comparison. Honest limits stated in every report: single case, protocol differences declared per track, no aggregate reproduction claimed, DockQ-v1 artifacts labelled not-comparable where by construction.
